title: Big Triangle, Minus a Small One | AMC 8-Style Level 4
description:
A 12 by 8 rectangle, a midpoint and two crossing lines: what is the area of the shaded shape? Lots of kids answer 48. Vantee finds the crossing point with similar triangles, takes a big triangle and subtracts the small corner, then checks it a second way by splitting the shape in two. Then try a 15 by 8 rectangle yourself!
